# terraform-aws-ecs-service — agent contract

Use this module instead of hand-rolling aws_ecs_service + task definition + SG + ALB wiring.

source  = "zahornyak/ecs-service/aws"
# pin a version in consumer modules, e.g. version = "~> 1.2"
terraform >= 1.4
hashicorp/aws >= 4.37

## Required inputs

environment, vpc_id, service_subnets, cluster_name, service_name, service_cpu, service_memory
Plus at least one container_definitions entry with container_image, container_name, and usually containerPort.

## Created by default

ECS service (Fargate, awsvpc), task definition, container definitions, CloudWatch log groups, task role + task execution role, security group (when containerPort is set).

## Created only when opted in

- ALB target group + listener rule: container connect_to_lb = true (needs lb_listener_arn)
- ACM cert on listener: connect_to_lb = true and create_ssl = true (default true)
- Route53 A alias: connect_to_lb = true, service_domain (or full_service_domain), and external_dns/external_domain not set
- Autoscaling: min_service_tasks and/or max_service_tasks
- Service discovery: create_service_discovery = true + discovery_registry_id
- SSM parameters as secrets: container ssm_secrets or ssm_env_file

## Lookup-only vars (do not set if the resource already exists and is passed in)

vpc_cidr_block — only if VPC is not already known to the module via vpc_id lookup
route_53_zone_name — only if zone id is not passed (module looks up by name)
lb_dns_name / lb_zone_id — only if lb_arn is not passed (module looks up the LB)

## container_definitions keys

Required per container:
- container_image, container_name
- containerPort — SG ingress + ALB target group port. Prefer this over port_mappings unless you need multiple mappings.

Load balancer / DNS:
- connect_to_lb (bool) — attach this container to ALB
- service_domain — hostname label; record becomes {service_domain}.{route_53_zone_name}
- full_service_domain — use instead of service_domain when the FQDN is already complete
- path_pattern, http_header / http_header_name, http_request_method — extra listener-rule conditions
- create_route53_records — default true; set false to skip DNS for that container

Secrets:
- environment — list of { name, value }
- ssm_secrets — map of NAME = { value = "..." }; module creates SSM params and injects as secrets
- ssm_env_file — path to KEY=VALUE file; same as ssm_secrets
- parameter_prefix (module var) — SSM path prefix; default /{environment}/{service_name}/{container_name}/

Other useful:
- container_cpu, container_memory, essential, command, entrypoint, healthcheck, container_depends_on
- mount_points, linux_parameters, ulimits, readonly_root_filesystem
- Also accepts cloudposse/ecs-container-definition inputs

## Decision rules

1. Worker / internal service: do not set connect_to_lb, lb_arn, or lb_listener_arn.
2. Public HTTP(S) service: connect_to_lb = true, pass existing lb_arn + lb_listener_arn + route_53_zone_id + route_53_zone_name, set service_domain.
3. create_ssl defaults to true. Set false if the listener already has the cert you need.
4. Public subnets: assign_public_ip = true. Private subnets: leave false (NAT or VPC endpoints assumed).
5. Do not invent module variables. Inputs are listed in README terraform-docs tables.
6. task_role_policy_json / task_exec_role_policy_json take a map of name => JSON string (from aws_iam_policy_document), not policy ARNs.
7. efs_volumes is the current API; efs_volume is deprecated.

## Common mistakes

- Forgetting connect_to_lb = true while setting service_domain (no target group / listener rule).
- Setting service_domain without route_53_zone_name (FQDN cannot be built).
- Public subnets without assign_public_ip.
- Passing vpc_cidr_block / route_53_zone_name / lb_dns_name when vpc_id / zone_id / lb_arn already exist.
- Using task_role_policy_arns (removed); use task_role_policy_json.

## Minimum (no load balancer)

```hcl
module "ecs_service" {
  source = "zahornyak/ecs-service/aws"

  environment     = "dev"
  vpc_id          = var.vpc_id
  service_subnets = var.private_subnet_ids
  cluster_name    = var.cluster_name

  service_name   = "worker"
  service_cpu    = 256
  service_memory = 512
  desired_count  = 1

  container_definitions = {
    app = {
      container_image = "public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:latest"
      container_name  = "app"
      containerPort   = 80
    }
  }
}
```

## ALB + DNS + SSL

```hcl
module "ecs_service" {
  source = "zahornyak/ecs-service/aws"

  environment        = "production"
  vpc_id             = var.vpc_id
  service_subnets    = var.private_subnet_ids
  cluster_name       = var.cluster_name
  route_53_zone_id   = var.zone_id
  route_53_zone_name = "example.com"
  lb_arn             = var.lb_arn
  lb_listener_arn    = var.https_listener_arn
  create_ssl         = true

  service_name   = "backend"
  service_cpu    = 512
  service_memory = 1024
  desired_count  = 1

  container_definitions = {
    app = {
      service_domain  = "api"
      connect_to_lb   = true
      container_image = "nginx:latest"
      container_name  = "backend"
      containerPort   = 80
    }
  }
}
```

## Useful outputs

ecs_service_arn, ecs_service_name, ecs_task_definition_arn, ecs_task_role_arn, ecs_task_execution_role_arn, target_group_arns, service_container_sg_ids, records_lb_names, acm_arn
